review_description: Tom was very informative regarding the system, however the biggest positive was Gareth, his primary installer. Gareth was very knowledgeable, considered our existing HWS and the electrical setup, given a house extension and then gave us reasons why we should do the install a certain way.There were a few hiccups due to a manual switch for the existing HWS and a return data cable for monitoring of the entire electrical circuits, but Gareth sorted these on subsequent visits.Overall, I am happy with the install and would recommend them!

Quoting process was thorough with room for slight changes.Installation was done in 1 day & Tom organised the grid connection efficiently.They will be back for a review in the new year & follow up on questions.

I was contacted by Freedom Energy Solutions within 48 hours of requesting a quote. They answered all my many questions on multiple occasions and came up with the appropriate battery system for my situation and a very competitive price. Although they weren’t the cheapest quote their customer service and their willingness to make sure I completely understood the system I was buying and the installation process was the reason I signed.Despite some delays in installation I’m very happy with the result. Jared, who installed my battery and hybrid inverter was efficient friendly and helpful in making sure the battery was installed in the best location. I can’t speak highly enough about the efforts he went to to ensure the installation was right.

Right from the beginning of the process including the quotation process, system sizing, consultation, ordering and final installation and commissioning, dealing with Freedom Energy was professional and friendly.The installation was undertake with great care and professionalism.  During the installation genuine consultation was undertaken to check configuration details and placement of the system components. This was particularly relevant to our specific Backup circuit requirements and distance between the house (Gateway panel) and the location of the system (solar/controller/batteries).Great care was taken to ensure:- the system was installed to provide optimum performance- was neatly installed (conduit runs and cabling, solar panel placement)- aesthetically pleasing, solar panels and inverter/controller/battery installation- Safety and serviceability of the overall system, including the re-configured switchboard

Freedom Energy Solutions Group seemed to tick all the boxes and went out of their way to get the job done well.The sales/ quoting process (Tom) was very helpful and patient and was very easy to work with.The installation was done by a 'very well oiled machine' and the electrician did more than he needed to do, explaining things well and working hard in the process. There was a 40 metre trench from the shed where the panels went to the fuse box which added to the task and he corrected the dodgy power cable that already existed.The customer service has been excellent.
Great bunch of blokes had everything done by mid arvo answered all my questions didn’t stop working until it was finished I would recommend these guys to anyone
All questions were answered when talking to company rep & same with the installers. The installation itself was well done without any dramas.

The sales/quoting process was highly professional: friendly, efficient, and informative. The installation was executed in a professional manner; the installers were polite, punctual and eminently competent. The customer service was pleasing, with only one small issue that was promptly attended to that had been overlooked but did not concern the installation process. All in all, a well run business and first-rate product.

Before purchasing, I wanted to be educated on panels (types, differences, value for money), the benefits of solar and how to maximise the benefits, and how a system works. Tom from Freedom did all this and without being asked. Our conversation started with Tom explaining solar energy and systems before we even discussed their offerings. He gave me time to think and supported me in my decision. I never felt like I was being pushed into a sale, he was genuine and he knew his stuff.The installation went well, the team were efficient and very polite.The process from end to end was 5 stars.The system is generating more power than we can use and thanks to Tom's advice, we are adjusting our power usage to maximise the solar generated energy and minimise pulling from the grid.Thank you, Freedom Energy Solutions!

Total contact with Freedom was very professional  From the quoting process to the installation of the system the Team were prompt, efficient and totally professional and I would recommend their services to other interested customers
The sale and quoting process was quick and easy. The installers were great. Very polite and punctual. Once installed, they provided help in getting the grid connection post install.
We installed a13 kw system and have dropped our bill down to near nothing. Exceptional installation, workmanship and customer services fantastic.
Responsive, easy to contact, kept us up to date, explained the process clearly.

In the beginning: quoting of options was helpful, factual, not hounded by sales staff, preferred products were accommodated.During installation: most completed in one day and panel installation, cable routing and battery install neat and aesthetically pleasing.The end: property left spotless and questions answered after commissioning.

After many calls to other suppliers it was pleasing to find Freedom Energy Solutions. I found Tom who I believe is the principal to be interested in my situation & requirements. His choices/suggestions of product for my application matched my prior investigations.My system was installed only last week by the Freedom team. All three installers came across as decent guys who carried out a a great install. It was great to see all ‘waste’ cleaned up leaving my property as clean as it was prior to their arrival.I am now waiting for my sparkie to connect to the grid, which I’m sure will occur with no dramas.At this stage I’ve been very satiated with Solar Quotes & Freedom Energy Solutions.

Tom followed up on my initial enquiry the next day.   Understood what we wanted, quote was prompt and detailed.  Always calls me back promptly, answered any questions quickly.Install team was great, couldn’t fault them.  Friendly, funny and easy going.Gareth, electrician, great attention to detail.Measured everything a few times, got the best fit of the panels on the roof.  Very knowledgeable and cares about what he does.Everything was neat and tidy, straight and level.  Did not leave any mess.Explained clearly how the system works.Getting battery installed next.

Tom and Jamie were very helpful, knowledgeable and approachable, listening to our concerns and explaining any reservations we had about the design of the system as we have some shading issues on our roof.We were replacing an old and useless small system we inherited when we bought the house. We were able to negotiate the removal of the old system at no extra cost which was a big selling point for us as well.Gareth, the installer suggested some changes to the quoted design once he had a good look at our roof layout and the resulting installation is far more aesthetically pleasing pleasing than the original design. Gareth is very passionate and enthusiastic about solar and has a wealth of experience. We asked if he could install the inverter in a more sheltered position under the carport as opposed to position of the inverter he was replacing which was exposed to the afternoon sun. He was more than happy to oblige even though this required a lot more cabling and conduit. I highly recommend Gareth's installation work - very neat, tidy and professional. He also explained that Freedom Energy do an annual check of the system at no extra cost to ensure everything is working as it should.

Original quote was supplied very quickly & once selected system was agreed upon installation occurred after just 2 weeks. Installation was carried out very professionally by highly experienced staff along with a full explanation of how the system worked.

We went with Tom from Freedom Energy Solutions as he was helpful, not pushy, answered our questions and was easy to work with. The team who installed the system were excellent, hard working and left  everything tidy. Tom kept us in the loop if something needed to change I.e. heavy rain on installation day. We have had no issues with this company and would highly recommend them.

For our family choice in moving forward with solar gave Freedom Energy as the leader that stood clear from the other competitors in the field. After five on sites assessments, consultations and quotes we had no hesitation choosing Freedom Energy. From this the install then exceeded our expectations and this overall experience and has made the choice one that we will recommend to anyone of our friends and family who are examining this option to improve their carbon footprint and reduce their energy costs. Thankyou to Tom and the work engine behind the company. Mark and Alicia.

Freedom Energy Solutions provided a great service and everything is going well. Tom was informative when getting the quote and willing to change the quote to meet the requirements. He has been contactable on any issues we had. The crew was also great on time, quick, willing and very informative making sure everything went right. We can recommend FES to anyone requiring solar.
Very neat and tidyApp is great and installers were wonderful

The Sales and quoting process was a breeze. Prompt and clear communication. They explained my options and answered all my questions. The installation was also a breeze. They turned up on time, were polite and quick.They also took care of the paperwork to get the installation registered with my supplier.

Tom was very patient during the quoting process ,but  we did get it right in the end. could not be happier with the installation or his crew,10,5 KW system installed on a new trimdek roof,they took extra care to avoid any damage. Great customer service and they are organising the grid connection, I am still waiting to hear from the energy retailer.

We looked at a number of solar installation companies and had quotes from each. We decided to go with Freedom Energy solutions because they took the time to explain the options and discuss the placement and types of inverter and panels that were available for us.We chose a single phase system producing 13.5 Kwh. We run a small business from our home, which involves large freezers continually operating as well as pumps etc. and this system we determined, was the best for our needs.Freedom Energy solutions were not the cheapest quote, we went with them because they were willing to discuss all aspects of the installation, were flexible in locating the panels and inverter to achieve the best outcome for us and were not pushy. The panels we chose were middle of the road. Installation was booked in and completed in a timely manner . The installers were polite and knowledgeable and were happy to show me through the panels and inverter before their installation.The end result was a neat installation, the installers cleaned up after themselves. We are very happy with the product and the process.
Sales and quoting was good, did not have any problems with installation.

We were very happy with the solar installation. It was a large installation during a very hot period. The installation took longer than predicted but was completed competently and to our satisfaction.

The sales quoting process was fairly simple and easy. I was told the panels would be cheaper due to an influx of people purchasing solar systems before the end of the year, therefore could be purchased in bulk. I would say I ended up paying regular price for the panels. It was hard to get a quote that had detailed prices on all items needed for the install.The  installation was good. The guys turned up on time and were hard at work during the hottest times of the day. It was nice to see professionalism and quality in their work as well as using some common sense (which isn't that common these days). They cleaned up after themselves and were very friendly and easy to get along with. The end product was tidy and professional.Customer service was good. We had a few issues with the inverter that didn't get sorted until the following Monday, but I believe this was a Sungrow issue, and after updating the system on Monday it came online. They did organise the grid connection but electricity company are yet still to come and do whatevr they need to do to the power board.Overall happy with the communication, workmanship and install quality.
Freedom was very easy to deal with and very professional. They communicated every step of the process.The installers were polite, friendly and professional as well.

The overall experience dealing with Tom and the team at Freedom energy has been great. In the initial conversations prior to receiving the quote they provided plenty of information on their solutions on offer and answered all the questions we had. The installation team they were friendly, professional and did a fantastic job with a high level of workmanship. On completion of the installation the installers walked us through the Fronius monitoring app and also lodged the application for the grid connection.
Installation guys were polite &,,well mannered and neat, cleaned up all the bits that this job makes. overall really nice guys

Prompt quote. Asked for Catch Solar Relay. Quickly reworked the quote. Very friendly and helpful . Quality components. Only 6 weeks from quote acceptance to installation. Installers were friendly, helpful, made some minor modifications on-site and fixed a couple of minor issues with our meter board while they were on site.Could not have been easier.

The sales phase was very smooth and I was provided a number of options and combinations to consider. The installation was fine, all up in one day. Showed up a little later than advised however. But very happy with the design and final product. If there was anything to fault I would say that between signing off on the quote and install date there was limited communication in terms of updates which I found to be slightly lacking.

Process was smooth from initial contact quotation through installation and operation. Firm was easy to deal with and the installation was completed in a timely manner through less than ideal weather conditions. Subsequent contact has been readily available

Dealt with the same person who was present for installation. Tom was happy to explain options available and was quick to provide a quote. Once a system was picked I had the paperwork within 24hrs. Was a short delay without contact between contract in installation. Prior to install was contacted, team arrived when they said. Guys were great, power was only out for 15-30min at most, install looks good, nil issues since installed 3-3 months ago.

Tom, the owner of Freedom Dolar contacted me within a few hours, giving me a quote, with layout pictures, the same day.The installers were polite, efficient and friendly.Installation happened in a day +2 hours.And the company pushed to have the solar panels attached and working before Christmas.

The sales experience was very informative they answered all  our questions. The installation was great the installer's worked hard and were lovely guys. They showed us how to download the app so we can monitor our system.can't fault anything.
Very Happy with SolarQuotes service, the installer we chose and the products used. The system is ground mounted with top quality framing. System is working well, saving us money.
From the moment the guys arrived they were straight into it only took 21/2 hours, brilliant

Freedom Energy Solutions answered all our questions and gave us plenty of time to consider our options before we decided to purchase. The install took some time to organise but we received regular communication and the process wes pretty seamless. The install was completed quickly and professionally and the installers cleaned up all their mess before leaving. The solar is working well and there have been no issues, I highly recommend them.

The sales/ quoting process was excellent, the installation was quick and professional with a friendly team. Grid connection the same day. Early days but expect everything should run smoothly. A bit hard to contact for some additional information but we believe Tom has been extremely busy with a big project.
Very tidy job done by professional  team.freedom byron bay was very easy to deal withTom and his team were great
Very good to deal with. Call you back when they say they will, and not a rip off for the same good brands.

I dealt with Tom Sexton from freedom and found him to be both friendly and professional. The install went well. Turned up when advised. Installers were very good. System looks good and is working well. Just waiting AGL to have the system connected to the grid in the next week. This has taken more time than l would have liked.

Tom and the team just completed a second solar installation for me. First one being a 15kw East/West split with 2x 5kw Fronius inverters on my home about 18 months ago and the system has worked flawlessly. Second being a 25kw system on my commercial property with 51x 510watt Trina panel’s matched with a Fronius 25kw Eco. The communication was great and the install team were spot on, going above and beyond to get perfection. Highly recommend.
Tom is a great communicator and understood that we were after personalised service. We felt we could trust Tom and he kept us informed through the whole process.
Professional, polite and knowledgeable - couldn’t fault the techs that installed my system - definitely recommend this company

Installation went  well system seems to be fine however got my power bill with 28 days of operation  total power usage has gone up not down export of excess is as predicted but my total power bill has increased by $30. Not seeing any savings at all seems my solar production is being metered as coming from the power grid. Still waiting for freedom energy to reply not sure where to go next but there is something seriously wrong with this
Quoting was very efficient and comprehensive.Installation was on time.Still waiting for the grid connection

I’ve had solar panels at a previous property for maybe 10 years, and the system operated flawlessly (I added a battery maybe 3 years ago).  When I moved to Urunga recently I wanted a solar system, so I sought quotes from 3 companies. One company annoyed me so much with constant sales calls that I blocked them.Freedom Energy Solutions quoted promptly in writing, with all details crystal clear. I had a few questions, and I received prompt answers that made sense.  I had stated a brand preference, but on Tom Sexton’s advice I ended up with another brand - a Sungrow inverter/battery system with 13 KW of panels.Tom and his team arrived on the appointed day, and completed the installation that same day.  There was nothing about the process that I could complain about - it went like clockwork. The next night (after the battery had charged up) I was sitting ogling the Sungrow App, monitoring my power flow. I’m the sort of bloke that gets a kick out of that!To date, the system has operated perfectly, so I consider my money well spent.Would I deal deal with Tom & Co again?  You bet.

Tom and his team did the job well, adapting to my availability.Tom was the first to provide a quote, and on this I was happy to sign with him.The installation was done within a reasonable time frame.The work was tidy and they didn't waste any time.Tom explained to me how to contact my retailer to organise a smart meter.He got back to me and answered my queries after the install.It pleases me to observe the power generation app, and anticipate the potential savings.

The sales/quoting process took a couple of weeks to sort due mainly to the overhead roof images used being out of date. Consequently the number of panels to be installed on the most favourable aspect was in doubt until I provided current images. The installer was very helpful in bringing extra panels when the installation took place with an agreement to adjust the quote accordingly as per the number of panels installed.The actual installation was on time, faultless, absolutely professional and finished leaving my property in perfectly tidy condition.The customer service from Tom at Freedom Energy was excellent with assistance to instal a digital power meter and provision of a digital (app) to monitor PV outputOverall we are entirely satisfied with the installation and would absolutely recommend Freedom Energy with Tom overseeing an installation.

Freedom Energy offered a competitive quote, communicated well through delays caused by weather and were punctual. the installation went well, the crew were efficient, polite and kept the site tidy and we are pleased with the result.We were upgrading from a smaller array and getting a Tesla battery. Jared, the electrician, came on the Thursday to install the battery and inverter and work on the switchboard. The job took longer than expected so he stayed overnight and finished on Friday, taking the trouble to connect the old array so we could see how the system worked over the weekend, before the new panels were installed.We are very happy with the result and everything is working as expected.
Good Company and good installation, neat, cleaned up and were ready to give information and advice. Early days yet but based on the job done we expect good follow up service.

There was a little too-ing and fro-ing but we got the paperwork for the quote - the acceptance, scheduling and installation were well communicated and efficient using IT for the paperwork/contract and rebate. Easy experience. Crew on the day were efficient and easy to deal with.

Solar Quotes was only able one supplier servicing our area, and local supplier(s) did not inspire confidence.  Tom responded to the invitation immediately, developed and explained the proposal fully, and provided the quotation quickly.  After further discussion the proposal was adjusted slightly, and after consideration accepted by us.The installation was planned quite quickly considering it was the holiday period, and Tom kept us well advised throughout.The installation took only 5 hours despite the fact that it was raining, was done very neatly and the work site left immaculately tidy.  The team were clearly competent and experienced and caused no concern.  The system was in service from completion and has given no concerns since.Tom took responsibility for organising the supplier, but the Smart Meter has not been installed yet; it is less than a week since installation.Overall, despite the lack of competitive quotations, the experience was excellent and we are satisfied that the system represented value for money.Thank you for your assistance.
Quick and easyPunctual, Polite and tidyCustomer service was fine
Excellent service from Tom and the boys very happy with whole process.

From start to finish Freedom Energy Solution communicated well with me as a client. The installation was quick and efficient. My system appears to be working well and I am very thankful. I could not recommend this company more highly.

Tom was extremely easy to deal with. Answered any questions I had and turned up when he said he would. Install is neat and tidy and staff were polite and knew their stuff. Great experience and I have already been recommending them to anyone that asks.
Quick and fast turn around from quote to install, will be using them again for my next system

The service was great. There was plenty of communication so I knew what was going on and they were good about reorganising things when I had a problem. I could ask questions and was treated well. Never felt I was asking 'dumb' things, though I probably was.The price was very reasonable.Installation was quick and I had no issues with the staff or their activities.The only issue I have is with the online program that tracks the solar collection. Its really hard to use beyond checking the Kwats per day and even that doesn't always work. But it's not their program so can't blame them for that.I have already recommended them to several people I know.

I chose Freedom Energy Solutions because they do not sub let to other installers. Tom and Steve who run the company, together with their electricians, did the installation. They arrived on time, were very friendly and answered all my questions. I was impressed by their professionalism and was very happy with the installation, which was neat and tidy, and looks good. I would highly recommend Freedom Energy Solutions.

All three quotes came in within a few days of first requesting. Chose to increase system size due to quite being under budget (more panels and larger inverter to increase output and savings). Chosen installer was onsite and system fully installed within 3 weeks of quote acceptance which was great considering COVID delays with stock.
Service was faultless any issues or questions they were happy to help and advise

Sales/Quoting was easy/quick. Tom took time to go through options, and we had a good exchange to find the right system. Unfortunately lack of site inspection (digital/phone only) meant that they didn't fully take into consideration roof pitch and site fall so the quote didn't allow for scaffolding. That set everything back and I needed to follow them up several times over Aug/Sept to get things happening. They did, to their credit, cover a fair bit of the cost of the scaffolding, but it still increased the budget.The install guys were good. They communicated well, were there when they said they would be etc.  They explained what was happening, what access they needed to the property (manhole etc, they had to remove a shade sail that they put back as found when they were done).After they were finished they took the time to set up the fronius app with me and show me how it works and followed up later to make sure it was all connected and that our power company had all the information they needed.The only stars lost in the review were because I needed to follow up on things to keep it happening and because of the cost blow outs.

I've used these guys three times over the years and have never had any issues so far.They're quick to respond and easy to deal with, even if you ask a million questions.They are reasonable and honest which many others are not. Hence why keep going back.Would definitely recommend to anyone.

The quoting process was prompt and willing to alter when changes were requested.The installation was polite, tidy, hardworking, and kept me informed of the process.Customer service: they are helping to organise the grid connection and how to set up the wifi connection.

Excellent communication. Accurate estimate on installation lead time. Reasonable on price.A few minor issues upon initial installation of my first 13kW solar system on the shed. The wiring of the fronius smart metre was not picking up the house usage but most importantly they returned within a few days and fixed it. I’ve since had a 6.6kW system installed on the house by the same supplier which all went well as expected. Very happy with the service and products
Great service. Good quality system. Fast install.thanks to the team.

Tom Sexton gave me great advice, He answered my phone calls and returned my calls without fail. His installers are very experienced. He installed my system in no time. Hasstle free and easy to get along with. He aslo gave me a free upgrade to better solar panels and solved my hot water issue for free as well.

Sales/quoting process was made so much easier when we can access your price guide. this is an example of "keep the bastards honest". Tom Sexton kept me in the loop all the way. The only hassle was that our power bill is in the name of my partner, and Tom put me down as the name on account.

A good experience as not just dealing with a salesperson working on commission, a personal service and although a problem came up, communication was good and it got sorted. Definitely better than dealing with just a voice on the phone
Explained what I needed, given information, installation date and price and it was done efficiently and effective.

Very happy with sales quoting . very happy with installation after a slight delay due to council aerial photo outdated and i had roof panel section which proved unsuitable for solar , but still has roof space for the system which i requested and i am personally happier with this layout design. Also My hot water system is manually controlled to be able to use the solar and not off peak electricity.The Grid , the new meter should be installed shortly

Quoting process was very good - salesperson was friendly, knowledgeable & was able to respond to all my queries. Provided me with a different inverter brand on request at no extra cost.Impressive turn-around time on the installation, and it was quick, professional and done with absolute minimum of fuss.

Tom was amazing to deal with from the start of our enquiry. We have been looking into solar for the last couple of years and we were never sure! We were told about Freedom Energy from a friend of ours and we had the best experience! They were professional, efficient and everything that we had spoken to Tom about was done and hassle free! I would recommend Freedom Energy if your looking for the best products and service!
They quoted me for what I asked for they came when they said they would very polite and tidy yes they did organise the grid connection

Tom at Freedom was quick to call and discuss our needs, and provided a competitive quote with a number of options for us. Once we ordered our system, Tom kept in touch and arranged install soon after. The team were all friendly, highly professional and installed or system quickly and hassle free. I would highly recommend Freedom Energy Solutions to anyone in the New England area looking for a professional solar installer.

Sales was excellent with quote for a very good system Fronius inverter with q-cell panels.Installation was quick and very professional all personnel were polite, tidy and punctual, dressed in their Freedom Energy uniforms.Grid installation was quick and well organised. Follow up is ongoing with Tom for a happy customer.

Tom and the team at Freedom Energy Solutions have impressed us from beginning to end;  the quotes were easy to follow and offered good comparisons, Tom was happy to answer all of our questions in detail, all communication has been clear and responsive, and the installation was prompt and efficient.  No surprises and easy to deal with. Highly recommended.
Tom and his staff were great, the whole process was so easy and simple, Tom explained everything to me so as I could understand it all. Thanks Tom.

Can speak highly enough of Tom and the team.  There response to the request for quote was quick and explained well. The time frame they said they needed to install was spot on. Very professional when they did the job. Very pleased with them
Tidy punctual organised all follow up with my energy provider and seemed happy to assist in future re any probs

Had Tom do a quote which was competitive we decided to go with the installation.When the guys arrived it was decided that a variation was needed where the panels could be better placed I was happy with their honest opinion and must say that our system is performing better than our expectation.Thanks Tom and team.

From start to finish, Tom, at Freedom Energy was wonderful to deal with. No question went unanswered and all was explained in plain English.The installation process took no time at all, they were punctual and efficient and there was no mess left behind.Customer Service was also fantastic, Tom organised everything with the grid connection.I highly recommend this company.
Great easy service from quote, to installation and after support!Liked that local English speaking service
Very happy with overall experience. Very helpful with sales and installation information. Would recommend Freedom Energy, especially Tom.
Great service and very professional.  I can't use any more words

Tom was excellent to deal with from start to finish. The whole experience was very easy. Tom and his team did a great job on the install. Very neat and tidy. Actually looks great!! Would definitely recommend Tom and his team to anyone looking at getting solar power. VERY HAPPY with ours!!!

Good, clear quotes, attention paid to my understanding & needs.The installation was quick, tidy and punctual. Friendly and helpful making sure we understood and offering follow up service.No I arranged that on a follow up call to my energy retailer.

The quoting  for the new system was exceptional.  Initial quotes received in a day. A further quote was organised after discussions regarding the best layout.The installation went without any problem  The team were on site the day any time specifies. The installation was completed that day. Tom and Pat were great to work with and considering they were a man down went beyond the call to complete the job. The installation area was left spotless after they finished the job.As we had an old Solar setup already connected there was no need arrange connection to the grid.The system was up and feeding back to the grid as soon as the job was complete/

Freedom energy were good to work with and provided 3 quotes.They were great at answering all my questions, and making sure I understood what I was getting to my satisfaction. They were happy to take my calls.Installation was quick and efficient. All the team were polite and helpful. They were tidy and punctual.Customer service was great, and they helped organize the grid connection and contacted our energy retailer

The price was comparable with other quotes, the quality rated highly but the interpersonal relationship with Tom Sexton, the information he freely shared to allow me to make my decision and the service he offered with installation was by far the best, most honest and easily understood.  Thanks you for your part in that process.

Simple straight forward sales and quotes. To the point with all information. Very polite and easy to get along with on install. Everything sorted for connection and always kept up to date on install times.  Very helpful and informative with optional payment plan.
They were hear on time and very efficient  and fast a great job  all round.

Freedom were the only company to quote.They rang to ascertain my requirements.I then received four quotes for fourvariances of their systems.Communication was excellent.They arrange a time and date and were punctual.There was no mess, no fuss.Excellent company to deal with. Thank you for your direction

Efficient, honest, direct sales process. Very easy communication. Installation was fast, on time. Everything was explained to me. Left a few wiring scraps, no big deal. Helped me with some heavy lifting independent of the job.Completed the job the next day after a prolonged power failure.Could have wished for better service.

Tom made the experience easy from start to finish.  Gave us a number options in terms of quality levels and price and enough details that I could do my our research and make a decision I was happy with.
Tom at Freedom was excellent to deal with and answered all my questions in a timely and informative manner. No hesitation in recommending this company to those looking to instal a solar system.

Very happy with the service and the system. Nothing was a problem and they were flexible to my requirements.I have no hesitation recommending Freedom to anyone.Thankyou to Solar quotes for sharing the knowledge.
Highly recommend Tom and his business they organised everything through to arranging grid connection.

From word go Tom got back to me straight away every time, considered every alternative to give me the best result that I needed for the best return on my system. When the installers came to the house, they left it the way it was when they got there. If it wasn't for the solar panels on my roof I would not have even known that they had been. Tom has promised to follow up with my bills to make sure I am getting the best return on my unused energy and to follow up on any issues I may have. Overall the whole process was easy, with no stress at all, the price was easily in the price range of other companies with similar manufacturers and Freedom did what they said the would, in the time frame that was given, any changes were always discussed with me and the job was done cleanly & efficiently. I couldn't be happier! I'm looking forward to my first electricity bill and I never thought I would ever say that!

I'd done quite a lot of research over the years and finally bit the bullet. I received 3 quotes through Solar Quotes and one locally. I nearly went local but couldn't resist Tom's deal. Being a few hours away from Tom's base I was a little apprehensive incase there were any issues in the future, but the team pack up and do regular road trips through my area so not really an issue.From go to whoa the whole process was great, I can't fault any part. The team of three were great guys and nothing was a problem. The install date went ahead as planned, the quality of work was top notch and after they left you wouldn't have known they'd even been.........except for the abundance of free electricity!

Tom made contact quickly and was available to answer all my questions. He provided me with 3 possible systems and links to the docs and reviews for the cells and inverter.  He arranged a date and his team arrived promptly and set straight to work. The installation was easy, quick, hassle-free and professional.  They were done in 3.5 hours.  Very happy. Highly recommended.

I contacted several companies to obtain solar quotes. Tom from Freedom Energy was the first company to contact me. Tom provided 4 quotes with various system combinations. Tom was very polite and informative, not pushy at all. The install took place on the date and time booked. However there is one area where I feel they could have done better.I wanted the new system to have three arrays of panels facing North, East, West.  I had found a technical paper written by Fronius (the inverter manufacturer) describing how under certain conditions it is possible to connect East and West panels to the one MPPT, with only minimal degradation to performance.  I believe my installation would meet the criteria stipulated.When the team arrived I discussed how the wiring of the East and West arrays would be done.  I was expecting wiring to be in  parallel, the installer said the East and West arrays should be wired in series.  I phoned Fronius technical support and had them speak to the installer.  Fronius insisted the connection of the two arrays had to be parallel.  However this would cause the input amperage limit to be exceeded due to the number of panels.  In the end, I instructed the installer to install the panels planned for East array to be added to the West array.The system produces more power in the afternoons due to the large West array.  Having an East array would have spread that power more evenly through the day.  I am very satisfied with the system as installed, but believe that FES should have contacted Fronius technical support ahead of the installation to better understand the workings of the East / West configuration.In fairness to the installer, I should also state that the Fronius article did not provide a clear summary of the conditions to be met for the East West configuration to work.  It was buried in the detail and not complete.The article can be found athttp://www.fronius.com/en-au/australia#!/tabs/tabb385235f-a196-45bd-bbb9-b862b034eaa4-d15783f0-1c50-4a57-8d04-0be3b9fd513athen search for East West in the download search.
